correctness.rationale: The counterexample uses an invertible one-dimensional synthesis operator, so the source pseudoinverse is unique. Exact substitution gives \(A=B=4\), \(\|T_\Lambda^\dagger\|=1/2\), relative constant \(\lambda=1\), and printed threshold \(2\), while the zero family lacks a positive lower bound. The repaired bounds follow from the Hilbert direct-sum triangle inequality, and the boundary is sharp because the zero family satisfies the relative inequality for every \(\lambda\ge1\).
